disposition: Keep the current V68/V53/V63 research candidate. The generated hitting feature yields tiny uncertain PA and offense gains, slightly worsens arrival scoring, does not repair prospect/return readiness or cohort totals, and still misses the public MAE allowance. This rejects promotion of this encoding, not the baseball relevance of hitting to opportunity. Audit support and representation of the underlying cross-level hitting estimate before another fit.
support_claim: All forecasts remain; refined active and rate profiles are absent for many minors. Positive DSL hitting estimates are unsupported extrapolations, not validated latent MLB ability. Nested earlier training rates have less precise support than outer-test rates.
baseball_limits: Thin elite entrants, productive upper-minors regular workload, medical/administrative returns and low-level latent ability remain unresolved. Injury-related realized gains are not injury forecasts; unusual Belt non-employment is not a retirement rule. This is next-year custom offense, not full WAR or control value.
